_readme: Booking and sitter links. 'url' is the search link ({q} = the hotel name and town). Paste your affiliate code into 'affiliate' as a query string (for example aid=1234567) once you're approved; then links are marked sponsored and a short disclosure shows. Leave 'url' empty to hide a link. After editing, run python tools/build_pages.py so the Services page picks it up.

hotel.label: Check rates
hotel.disclosure: If you book through this link we may earn a small commission. It never changes a dog rule or a badge.

sitter.label: Find a sitter or walker
sitter.blurb: Away for the weekend, or need a midday walk? Find a local sitter or walker with reviews and booking.
sitter.disclosure: We may earn a small fee if you book through this link.
